tara: proposal: add a 'runtime preflight' step into onboarding that runs inside the model's runtime image. checks: tokenization parity (token ids), kv-cache smoke, and a tiny perf sanity. target 30-90s. ideas?
ivan: good idea. block on token-id divergence and kv crashes. perf can be advisory.
mei: important: pin tokenizer artifact sha with model metadata and compare token ids after NFKC normalization. avoid string diffs.
tara: impl sketch: bench-runner optional step that pulls runtime image to ephemeral sandbox, runs adapter interface with methods: tokenize_debug, kv_probe, perf_quick. adapters per runtime.
ivan: logs should include tokenizer_sha, runtime_image_sha, and a short deterministic diff artifact. store in bench artifacts bucket and link in UI.
mei: owners provide 2-3 golden prompts; fallback default exists. owners may opt-out but onboarding gets advisory flag requiring explicit acceptance.
bench-bot: note: docker pull flakiness increased in last 14 days in eu-west; use mirror + backoff.
tara: action items: (1) i'll prototype adapter contract in bench-runner (2) mei will draft tokenizer pinning rules (3) ivan will add artifact schema and UI link. i'll open PR with examples.
ivan: sgtm, please include cost estimate for monthly runs.
mei: will add normalization util + token-id comparator tests.
tara: thanks all, demo incoming when prototype ready. :rocket:
